message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a heart rate monitor wristband with Bluetooth. Candidate headings are 9029.20 (speed indicators), 9031.80 (measuring instruments), 8517.62 (wireless apparatus for reception/transmission of data), and 9018.19 (electro-diagnostic apparatus).

CBP has classified similar fitness trackers and heart rate monitors under 8517.62.0090 as smartwatches or wearable devices that transmit data. However, a device that only monitors heart rate, with no smartwatch functions, is more likely to fall under 9018.19.9550 (other electrodiagnostic apparatus, including patient-monitoring apparatus). Optical PPG heart rate monitors have been ruled under 9018.19.9550 in the past, and the Spirit HRM measures physiological data, so I chose that.

```json
{"hts_code": "9018.19.9550", "reason": "A wrist-worn optical PPG heart rate monitor that measures and displays physiological data is classified as other electro-diagnostic (patient monitoring) apparatus under heading 9018."}
```
